描述_EN: the term porcelain is applied to ceramics made from a mixture of a clay called kaolin and a white stone called petuntse, which was fired at high temperatures. porcelains differ from other ceramics in their impermeability, their whiteness and fine texture. xing wares were very popular both domestically and abroad, and were exported as far away as north africa during the years between 800-1000ad. this lion figure is an example of xing ware, the earliest true porcelain made in china, and the world. chinese porcelains later achieved great popularity in western europe, although it was not until the early eighteenth century that european makers accurately duplicated true porcelain.
描述_ZN: 瓷器一词适用于由一种叫做高岭土的粘土和一种叫做Petuntse的白色石头的混合物制成的陶瓷，在高温下烧制。 瓷器与其他陶瓷的不同之处在于其不渗透性、白色和精细的纹理。 兴器在国内和国外都非常流行，在公元800-1000年期间被出口到遥远的非洲北部。 这个狮子图是邢器的一个例子，是中国和世界上最早的真正的瓷器。 中国的瓷器后来在西欧大受欢迎，尽管直到18世纪初，欧洲的制造商才准确地复制了真正的瓷器。
